list.name: Changes
list.comment:
fix(config): update css path in components configuration
- Changed css path from src/global.css to global.css - Removed trailing comma in aliases object - Fixed json formatting by removing extra closing brace

task.summary:
feat(styles): integrate Tailwind CSS with NativeWind for styling
- Add NativeWind and Tailwind CSS dependencies to project - Configure Babel preset for NativeWind JSX transformation - Set up Metro configuration with NativeWind integration - Add global CSS file with Tailwind directives - Update app layout to import global styles - Configure web bundler to Metro in app configuration - Add NativeWind type definitions for TypeScript support - Include Tailwind utility classes in main index component - Add prettier plugin for Tailwind CSS formatting - Create comprehensive Tailwind configuration files

refactor(layout): update project configuration and styling setup
- Add Prettier configuration file with consistent formatting rules - Replace AnimatedSplashOverlay with PortalHost in layout component - Integrate shadcn components configuration with proper aliases - Add EAS build configuration for development and production builds - Remove explore.tsx file to clean up unused route - Update global CSS with layered base styles and dark mode color palette - Configure Metro bundler with inline rem conversion for NativeWind - Install new dependencies including portal primitives, class utilities and dev client - Update Tailwind config with custom color palette and animations - Create theme utility files for consistent color management - Add utility function for class merging with Tailwind support

chore(project): clean up project structure and remove unused assets
- Remove Expo icon SVG and icon.json configuration files - Delete reset-project.js script file - Simplify _layout.tsx to basic Stack component - Replace complex index.tsx with simple placeholder component - Remove multiple UI components including Collapsible, AnimatedIcon, AppTabs, ExternalLink, HintRow - Delete theme constants and related hook files - Clean up CSS modules and image assets - Remove unused theme library file

feat(theme): add theme configuration and styling system
- Add global CSS with Tailwind directives and color variables for light/dark modes - Create theme configuration file with color definitions for both themes - Add navigation theme integration with Expo router - Implement utility function for class name merging - Update Metro config to use correct global CSS path - Adjust TypeScript path aliases to reference root directory
